title.en: OpenAI and Cisco launch open-source Shirudo eBPF Linux runtime defense
title.zhHans: OpenAI 与 Cisco 联合开源基于 eBPF 的 Linux 运行时防护工具 Shirudo

searchSummary.en: On November 23, 2026, OpenAI and Cisco open-sourced Shirudo, an eBPF-based Linux runtime designed to deploy temporary shields against exploits without rebooting while patches are rolled out.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 23 日，OpenAI 与 Cisco 联合开源基于 eBPF 的 Linux 运行时防护项目 Shirudo，旨在无需重启的情况下部署临时防护盾，填补漏洞披露至正式补丁上线之间的防御窗口。

summary.en: On November 23, 2026, OpenAI and Cisco jointly launched Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime built on eBPF that allows security teams and defensive agents to deploy temporary kernel-level compensating controls ('shields') without rebooting systems while permanent software patches are tested and rolled out. Both partners framed the tool as a response to faster AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and exploitation.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 23 日，OpenAI 与 Cisco 联合推出开源项目 Shirudo，基于 Linux eBPF 技术为安全团队及防御型代理提供内核级临时补偿防护机制（shield），使运行中的 Linux 系统无需重启即可在正式补丁测试与部署期间阻断漏洞利用。两家公司称该项目旨在应对 AI 加速漏洞发现与利用带来的“补丁窗口”压力。

narrative.en: Shirudo builds on eBPF kernel instrumentation (such as Tetragon/Cilium concepts) to bridge the gap between rapid AI-powered vulnerability discovery and multi-day enterprise patching cycles. While OpenAI and Cisco cited a controlled test blocking Java4Shell without restarts, independent real-world production adoption and false-positive behavior across unaffiliated Linux fleets have not yet been observed.
narrative.zhHans: Shirudo 依托 eBPF 内核插桩技术（如 Tetragon/Cilium 理念），试图弥合 AI 加速发现漏洞与企业多日补丁周期之间的时间差。尽管合作方提及在受控测试中无需重启阻断 Java4Shell 的演示结果，但无关联企业在真实生产 Linux 集群中的采用情况及误报影响尚未得到独立观察。

text.en: On November 23, 2026, OpenAI and Cisco launched Shirudo, an open-source eBPF-based Linux runtime for deploying temporary pre-patch compensating controls without system reboots.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 23 日，OpenAI 与 Cisco 联合开源基于 eBPF 的 Linux 运行时项目 Shirudo，用于在不重启系统的前提下部署补丁前临时补偿防护。
